findings.claim: The new early `return null` when `suppressSourceGeneration is true` runs before any member inspection, so a `[MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)]` type gets no analyzer diagnostics at all. L12 exempts only the generation-only rules (MsgPack011/016/017) for suppressed types. This silences the analyzer for exactly the case REQ-2234 says must work, instead of restoring 3.1.0 behaviour.
